question: AJK is related to BKL in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, DOT is related to EPU. To which of the following is PJO related following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'AJK is related to BKL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7dc702a961559e0f954e50f3a81b54ccd204b9199ecfb3c21af6d446518e290.png] 

For, 'DOT is related to EPU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a16dd43b2d60b44e06327dd9aed3ca9f70bad72e21bb4c436caffa95e149db2e.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e4f052e0a0dd534ffec8731a4d030e922f346b194df81effa7a07da9bc52dd0.png]
